info.name: Metrc Sandbox API v2
info.description: Metrc API v2 endpoints for Sandbox. All endpoints are sandbox-only and return an error in production.

item.name: GetSandboxTagTypes
item.description: Bulletin 233 (effective 2026-04-23). Returns the list of tag types available for a sandbox facility. Use this endpoint to discover valid TagType values before calling POST /sandbox/v2/facility/tags.

item.name: GenerateSandboxFacilityTags
item.description: Bulletin 233 (effective 2026-04-23). Generates tags of a specified type for a sandbox facility. Tags are created, shipped, and received in a single synchronous operation, making them immediately available for use in packages and plant batches. Maximum 1,000 tags per request. Only one tag type may be generated per request.
